input.html:
Classic Spaghetti Carbonara

A traditional Italian pasta dish.

Ingredients

  • 400g spaghetti
  • 200g guanciale or pancetta
  • 4 large egg yolks
  • 100g pecorino romano
  • Freshly ground black pepper

Method

  1. Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
  2. Meanwhile, cut the guanciale into small strips and fry until crispy.
  3. Beat the egg yolks with grated pecorino and black pepper.
  4. Drain pasta, reserving some cooking water. Toss with guanciale off heat.
  5. Add egg mixture, toss quickly. Add cooking water if needed for creaminess.

Serves 4. Total time: 25 minutes.

input.html:
Simple Tomato Soup

Prep: 10 mins | Cook: 30 mins

What you need

2 tins chopped tomatoes, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 500ml vegetable stock, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper

How to make it

1. Dice the onion and garlic. Heat oil in a large saucepan. 2. Fry onion until soft, add garlic for 1 minute. 3. Add tomatoes and stock, bring to a boil. 4. Simmer for 25 minutes. 5. Blend until smooth and season to taste.

Makes 4 bowls.

input.html:
Vegan Thai Green Curry

Difficulty: Easy | Time: 35 minutes | Serves 4

Ingredients

  • 1 tin coconut milk
  • 2 tbsp green curry paste
  • 200g tofu, cubed
  • 1 red pepper, sliced
  • 100g baby sweetcorn
  • Handful of Thai basil
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • Jasmine rice to serve

Method

  1. Heat a splash of coconut milk in a wok until bubbling.
  2. Fry the curry paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
  3. Add remaining coconut milk, tofu, pepper and sweetcorn.
  4. Simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
  5. Stir in soy sauce and Thai basil. Serve over jasmine rice.
